items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Yeah, with Big Eye Lewis, yeah. ... I think I worked there four years and Lewis worked there nine years. ... when I was playing with Landry and Lewis

ctx.x: That's what made me pick up and get a chance to play. That was the Bletchens you're talking about when Big Eye Lewis.
Yeah, with Big Eye Lewis, yeah.
Was Ernest Rogers the drummer with you in those days?
